params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Anonymous callers may use `view` and `embed` only.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific ids.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific ids.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Limit the response to specific top-level fields. A WordPress-wide sparse-fieldset control — the single most effective way to reduce payload size on this API.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific category terms.

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific category terms.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific tag terms. No effect on this deployment — the tags taxonomy is empty.

params.name: sticky
params.description: Limit result set to items that are sticky.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned one or more statuses. Anonymous callers may only request `publish`.

items.docs: Lists published posts — 61 at harvest time, spanning FDA designations, clinical and scientific news, conference appearances, media coverage and opinion pieces. Total count and page count are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages headers.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the post.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Anonymous callers may use `view` and `embed` only.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the post if it is password protected.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Limit the response to specific top-level fields. A WordPress-wide sparse-fieldset control — the single most effective way to reduce payload size on this API.

items.docs: Retrieves a single published post by numeric id.
